text: Inference spectral migration landed in 1aadb27. Thin local adapters delegate dense SVD, symmetric eigen, and SPD generalized eigen to Gale; ascending eigen layouts are explicitly reversed to preserve leading-root-first contracts, and SVD VT is explicitly transposed. Immutable multiblock consensus accumulation replaces the old mutable DoubleMatrix assumption. Independent R fixture families and repeated-subspace tolerance checks pass in 64 JVM and 64 JS tests.
